title: CA-515's threshold-shard filename fix landed in 1 of 6 copies of that spec: skills/implement/SKILL.md:107/:111 now write qc-shard-pass-w{wave_num:02d}-{NN}.md, but five copies still specify the pre-fix ordinal-only name -- skills/implement/SKILL.md:84-85 (the SAME file's normative QC-output-paths bullet, 22 lines above its own fixed pseudo-code), agents/edm-qc-auditor.md:81 (the WRITING AGENT's own output contract, whose worked example is literally the colliding qc-shard-pass-01.md), hooks/hooks.json:117, plugins/edm/CLAUDE.md:107 and :696; per CLAUDE.md's own intent-to-file index the agent file is authoritative for how an agent reports, so a wave-2 sub-threshold QC pass rewrites wave 1's filename and silently discards wave 1's PASS/FAIL verdicts (which SKILL.md:90-91 confirms live nowhere else) -- exactly the clobber CA-515 was filed to close, unfixed at the only site governing the writer; the divergence is invisible to CI because wave7-smoke.sh:9387-9388 asserts the STALE qc/qc-shard-pass-{NN}.md is PRESENT in agents/edm-qc-auditor.md while :9396-9399 asserts the NEW wave-component form is present in skills/implement/SKILL.md -- the suite pins both sides of the contradiction, and the CA-515 positive control at :9400-9404 only sed-transforms the skill file's own string so it cannot detect an unswept sibling; the merge glob qc-shard-pass-*.md matches either shape so the merge step is genuinely unaffected (the :118-119 comment is right about that) -- the defect is purely the unswept filename spec, and also a CA-416 spec_swept failure; fix: sweep all five stale copies, CHANGE wave7-smoke.sh:9388 which currently pins the bug, and add a cross-file token-equality pin in the ca473_tokens shape at :9340-9375
